primaryTextRead.text: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.
By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

wikipediaRead.locator: A–K一覧のJobab節、4245–4250行。五人の同名者を区別し、歴代誌上8:9の人物をシャハライムとホデシュの子として挙げる。
